def lens(L,e,k=12):
    w2=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.experts.{e}.w2.weight')
    Uu,S,V=torch.linalg.svd(w2,full_matrices=False)
    out=[]

import torch
al=sorted({int(x.split('.')[2]) for x in names() if 'self_attn.v_proj' in x}); print(al)
print(shape(f'model.layers.{al[0]}.self_attn.v_proj.weight'), shape(f'model.layers.{al[0]}.self_attn.out_proj.weight'))
E=W('model.embed_tokens.weight'); n=W('model.embedding_norm.weight')
dig=[encode(str(d))[0] for d in range(10)]
Xd=E[dig]; Ud=(E[dig]*n)
for L in al:
    V=W(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.v_proj.weight'); O=W(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.out_proj.weight')
    nkv=V.shape[0]//64; g=32//nkv
    on=W(f'model.layers.{L}.operator_norm.weight')
    sc=[]
    for h in range(32):
        kv=h//g
        Vh=V[kv*64:(kv+1)*64]; Oh=O[:,h*64:(h+1)*64]
        M=(Xd*on)@Vh.T@Oh.T@Ud.T   # 10x10
        M=M/M.abs().mean()
        sc.append((M.diag().mean()-(M.sum()-M.diag().sum())/90).item())
    t=torch.tensor(sc); top=torch.topk(t,6)
    print(L,'nkv',nkv,[(i,round(v,2)) for i,v in zip(top.indices.tolist(),top.values.tolist())])

args.generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
ones=['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten','eleven','twelve','thirteen','fourteen','fifteen','sixteen','seventeen','eighteen','nineteen']
tens=['','','twenty','thirty','forty','fifty','sixty','seventy','eighty','ninety']
def w(n):
    if n<20: return ones[n]
    t,o=divmod(n,10)
    return tens[t]+('' if o==0 else '-'+ones[o])
shots=[(42,),(70,),(18,)]
def item(n,ctrl):
    head='Write each number in digits.\n' if not ctrl else 'Repeat each number word.\n'
    s=head
    for (m,) in shots:
        s+=f"{w(m)}: {m if not ctrl else w(m)}\n"
    s+=f"{w(n)}:"
    return {'prompt':s,'answer':' '+(str(n) if not ctrl else w(n).split('-')[0])}
nums=random.sample([n for n in range(21,100) if n not in (42,70)],70)
items=[item(n,False) for n in nums]
control=[item(n,True) for n in nums]
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))

L39 expert 63 had 8x the median energy in the digit/round-number unembedding subspace, and its top direction writes 30/20/50/25/40. Ablating L39 [63,22,58,53] dropped math .281 while random same-size parts dropped about 0. It still failed the screen because chinese_numeral, another skill that outputs numbers, dropped .132 against a .094 limit. Without e63, math fell to .096. Don't run two built-in or agent skills that both output Arabic numbers.", "[lfm2_24b_a2b] A huge attribution score on one expert often marks a generic hub. L38 e36 had math attribution .277 (20x the next unit) and chinese_numeral .743, and its top direction writes <|startoftext|>/<|im_start|>. Ablated with e38 and e3 it dropped math .65, chinese_numeral .95 and roman_numeral's control .98. Read the logit lens before building a set around the top-attributed expert.", "[lfm2_24b_a2b] Clean writer experts in the weights were inert when ablated (drops under .03). Examples: L33 e14 writes '(' (code z=7), L36 e2 writes la/une, L37 e53 writes au/à, L38 e18 writes d'/l', the code-router experts at L15, and number writers at L34/L35 that also matched math attribution. In this MoE, only the last layer (L39) had expert sets that bottleneck a skill. Code and French look spread across many experts.", "[lfm2_24b_a2b] Digit-copy scores on attention value/output weights (layers 2, 6, ..., 38) found strong heads that turned out to be shared hubs. L30 GQA group 6 (heads 24-27, h24 score 3.69) dropped math .585 but also roman .957, month .952 and weekday .806. L38 heads 0/2/8/11 (scores about 5) together dropped math .205, while either GQA group alone dropped it only about .05, so the heads are redundant.", "[lfm2_24b_a2b] Early-layer experts with high a_an_article attribution (L5 e34 1.07, L10 e25 .76) dropped the target about .8, but also dropped its own control .9-.97 and moved antonym/month/weekday by .3-.5. A large attribution score on a low-base skill (base .15) often means general-text disruption. Check that the control is stable before screening.", "Plan the 8 agent-skill slots ahead of time. The cap was already full, so I couldn't define a number-word-to-digits skill to test the L39 number writers without the chinese_numeral clash. Keep 1-2 slots free for skills that the weight reading suggests mid-run."]}
